title: Past simple / continuous
recall: Past simple va past continuous farqi nima? 'when' va 'while' bilan bittadan misol ayt.
formula: Simple: tugagan harakat, ketma-ket voqealar — I worked / Did you work? / I didn't work
Continuous: o'tmishdagi bir lahzada davom etayotgan fon — I was working / Were you working?
Uzun fon (was -ing) + qisqa voqea (past simple): I was cooking when you called.

pairs.b: I was cooking dinner when you called.
When you called, I was leaving.
At 9 pm I was reading a book.

items.uz: Kecha men 8 soat ishladim.
en: I worked for 8 hours yesterday.
I worked 8 hours yesterday.
Yesterday I worked for 8 hours.
I worked for eight hours yesterday.

items.uz: Sen qo'ng'iroq qilganingda men ovqat pishirayotgan edim.
en: I was cooking when you called.
When you called, I was cooking.

items.uz: Biz ovqatlanayotganimizda chiroq o'chib qoldi.
en: The lights went out while we were eating.
While we were eating, the lights went out.
The power went out while we were eating.
The light went out while we were eating.

items.uz: Ali kelganda men uxlayotgan edim.
en: I was sleeping when Ali came.
When Ali came, I was sleeping.
I was sleeping when Ali arrived.
When Ali arrived, I was sleeping.
I was asleep when Ali came.

items.uz: Kecha soat 9 da nima qilayotgan eding?
en: What were you doing at 9 yesterday?
What were you doing at 9 o'clock yesterday?
What were you doing yesterday at 9?
What were you doing at nine yesterday?

items.uz: Men Malikani ko'rdim, lekin u meni ko'rmadi.
en: I saw Malika, but she didn't see me.

items.uz: Men eshikni ochdim, ichkariga kirdim va chiroqni yoqdim.
en: I opened the door, went in and turned on the light.
I opened the door, went inside and turned on the light.
I opened the door, went in and switched on the light.
I opened the door, went inside and switched on the light.

items.uz: Yo'lni kesib o'tayotganimda telefonimni tushirib yubordim.
en: I dropped my phone while I was crossing the road.
While I was crossing the road, I dropped my phone.
I dropped my phone while crossing the road.

items.uz: Yomg'ir yog'ayotgan edi, shuning uchun biz uyda qoldik.
en: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
It was raining, so we stayed home.

items.uz: Siz meni chaqirdingizmi?
en: Did you call me?

items.uz: Men kecha ishga bormadim.
en: I didn't go to work yesterday.
Yesterday I didn't go to work.

items.uz: Ular kecha soat 5 dan 7 gacha futbol o'ynashayotgan edi.
en: They were playing football from 5 to 7 yesterday.
Yesterday they were playing football from 5 to 7.
They were playing football from 5 till 7 yesterday.

items.uz: Men uyg'onganimda quyosh charaqlab turgan edi.
en: When I woke up, the sun was shining.
The sun was shining when I woke up.

items.uz: Sen bu filmni qachon ko'rding?
en: When did you see this film?
When did you watch this film?
When did you see this movie?
When did you watch this movie?

items.uz: Men u yerga 2020 yilda bordim.
en: I went there in 2020.

items.uz: Men ishlayotganimda akam televizor ko'rayotgan edi.
en: While I was working, my brother was watching TV.
My brother was watching TV while I was working.

items.uz: Men kitob o'qiyotgan edim, birdan telefon jiringladi.
en: I was reading a book when suddenly the phone rang.
I was reading a book when the phone suddenly rang.
I was reading a book and suddenly the phone rang.

items.uz: Kecha nima bo'ldi?
en: What happened yesterday?

items.uz: Men Londonda yashayotganimda ingliz tilini o'rgandim.
en: I learned English while I was living in London.
I learnt English while I was living in London.
I learned English when I was living in London.
When I was living in London, I learned English.
While I was living in London, I learned English.

items.uz: Biz uchrashuvga kechikdik.
en: We were late for the meeting.

items.uz: Malika menga hech narsa demadi.
en: Malika didn't tell me anything.
Malika didn't say anything to me.

items.uz: Mashina juda tez ketayotgan edi.
en: The car was going very fast.
The car was moving very fast.
The car was driving very fast.

items.uz: Seni ko'rganimda xursand bo'ldim.
en: I was happy when I saw you.
When I saw you, I was happy.
I was glad when I saw you.

items.uz: O'sha paytda qayerda ishlayotgan edingiz?
en: Where were you working at that time?
Where were you working then?
Where were you working at the time?

items.uz: Men kalitlarimni yo'qotdim va ularni ikki soat qidirdim.
en: I lost my keys and looked for them for two hours.
I lost my keys and searched for them for two hours.
I lost my keys and looked for them for 2 hours.

items.uz: Avtobus kelmadi, shuning uchun taksi oldim.
en: The bus didn't come, so I took a taxi.
The bus didn't come, so I got a taxi.

items.uz: Hamma gaplashayotgan edi, shuning uchun men hech narsa eshitmadim.
en: Everyone was talking, so I didn't hear anything.
Everybody was talking, so I didn't hear anything.
Everyone was talking, so I couldn't hear anything.
Everybody was talking, so I couldn't hear anything.

items.uz: Men dush qabul qilayotganimda kimdir eshikni taqillatdi.
en: Someone knocked on the door while I was taking a shower.
While I was taking a shower, someone knocked on the door.
Someone knocked on the door while I was having a shower.
While I was having a shower, someone knocked on the door.
Somebody knocked on the door while I was taking a shower.

items.uz: Sen nega kecha kelmading?
en: Why didn't you come yesterday?

items.uz: Biz yarim tungacha gaplashdik.
en: We talked until midnight.
We talked till midnight.

speak: Kechagi kuning haqida 5 ta gap ayt (past simple, ketma-ket voqealar).
Kecha soat 8, 12 va 18 da nima qilayotgan eding? (past continuous)
Bir voqeani gapir: nima bo'layotgan edi va birdan nima sodir bo'ldi (when / while).

film.en: While he was riding along the corridors, he saw two little girls.
film.note_uz: was riding — fon, saw — qisqa voqea

film.en: As the snow was falling outside, they realised they were trapped.
He told his wife that he was working late at school.
film.note_uz: told — tugagan, was working — o'sha paytdagi (bahona)
